subject: planner: refactor physical optimization to receive group as parameter and enumerate plans based on group (#61244)
summary: Reviewed this merge commit relative to its first parent. The change introduces memo-group based physical implementation via `pkg/planner/cascades/impl`, adds `memo.GroupExpression` routing for `ExhaustPhysicalPlans`/`FindBestTask`, and refactors core physical enumeration (`find_best_task.go`, `exhaust_physical_plans.go`) to accept group expressions. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the planner changes.
